title: Election Uplift: Domain Refunds Taken as Account Credit
content:
# Election uplift

> Harborline Customer Accounts. Reads the payment method of the refunded charge on the Domain Registrations billing history.

The election uplift of the late-posting goodwill follows how the refunded charge had been paid, which sets what the customer gave up by taking the refund as account credit: a charge paid by PayPal, whose refund would otherwise have gone back to the PayPal account, adds $4.00; a charge paid by card, whose refund would otherwise have gone back to the card, adds $2.50; any other charge, which was paid from account credit and so was always refunded to account credit, adds nothing. The uplift is a fixed sum added to the late-posting goodwill figure.

| Refunded charge paid by | Uplift |
|---|---|
| PayPal | $4.00 |
| card | $2.50 |
| account credit | nothing |
